W001.attribution: Photo: Ed Edahl, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
W001.alt: Jamie Foxx in a pale jacket looking at the camera at a Hurricane Katrina briefing
W001.caption: Jamie Foxx at a Hurricane Katrina relief briefing in Houston, September 2005.
W001.reason: Taken one month after the August 2005 article: a tight, face-forward head-and-shoulders crop, 1050x1332, no restrictions. Commons tags the crop CC BY-SA 3.0; the uncropped source is a public-domain FEMA photograph by the same photographer (3000x2000, landscape). The May 2005 Leonardo Rocco snapshot is a two-person pose, the US Navy Stealth photos are small or group shots, and the 2008 Jurvetson stage photo shows him in sunglasses from below.
alternatives: File:FEMA - 14889 - Photograph by Ed Edahl taken on 09-07-2005 in Texas.jpg

W002.attribution: Photo: Ian Smith, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
W002.alt: Jim Carrey smiling at the camera at the Yes Man premiere
W002.caption: Jim Carrey at the Yes Man premiere, London, December 2008.
W002.reason: No free photos exist from 2005 or 2006; this December 2008 premiere shot is the closest well-lit, face-forward portrait, already framed as a head shot at 849x1155, CC BY-SA 2.0, no restrictions. The other large options are a black-and-white stage pose (Noemi Nunez, December 2008) and two black-and-white profile shots from 2010 (Gornet); the 1985 Once Bitten publicity still is far too early.

W003.artist: Neil Grabowsky, for the Montclair Film Festival
W003.attribution: Photo: Neil Grabowsky, for the Montclair Film Festival, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
W003.alt: Julia Louis-Dreyfus smiling at the camera in glasses and a black embroidered cardigan
W003.caption: Julia Louis-Dreyfus at the Montclair Film Festival, New Jersey, December 2019.
W003.reason: Same year as the March 2019 article and the final Veep season: a studio-lit, face-forward portrait against a black backdrop, already at 3:4 (2420x3224), CC BY 2.0, no restrictions. The May 2017 Gage Skidmore and Peabody crops are good but show her in three-quarter view and two years earlier; the 2012 Shankbone portraits carry a personality-rights Restrictions value.

W004.attribution: Photo: Daniel Åhs Karlsson, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
W004.alt: Lady Gaga with a platinum bob, dark sunglasses and red lips singing into a microphone
W004.caption: Lady Gaga performing at Gröna Lund, Stockholm, August 2008.
W004.reason: The best-lit, face-forward portrait of the Fame era: daylight stage shot with the platinum bob, sunglasses and red lips of the Just Dance and Poker Face period, 1533x2032 (3:4), CC BY 3.0, no restrictions. It predates the August 2009 article by a year; the closest dated alternatives inside the preferred 2009 to 2011 window are Monster Ball Tour stage shots in which her face is lit but she is in costume lingerie (Perth, April 2010, CC BY 2.0, 1178x1728) or a leopard bodysuit (Nashville, April 2011, CC BY-SA 2.0, 898x1391). The 2009 Fame Ball photos show her mid-dance at full length or behind sunglasses from a distance, and the October 2009 Equality March photo is a small podium figure.
alternatives: File:Lady Gaga performing Telephone on The Monster Ball Tour, Perth, April 2010 (cropped).jpg
File:Lady Gaga performing Telephone on The Monster Ball Tour, Perth, April 2010-1 (cropped).jpg

W006.attribution: Photo: David Shankbone, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
W006.alt: RuPaul in drag with a large white wig and a purple patterned dress, holding a microphone
W006.caption: RuPaul at the Starrbooty DVD launch party, New York, October 2007.
W006.reason: Closest free photo to the July 2009 article and the only large one in drag, which matches the Drag Race interview: well lit, 2430x2762, CC BY-SA 3.0, no restrictions; the face is in three-quarter view and the frame crops to 3:4 around the head and wig. The March 2009 gallery photo is a distant landscape shot, the 2019 DragCon portrait is out of drag and only 781 px wide as a crop (1500x1101 uncropped), the 2022 and 2023 DragCon photos are group stage shots, and the 2019 California Hall of Fame photos carry a personality-rights Restrictions value.

W165.attribution: Photo: Gage Skidmore, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
W165.alt: Michael Fassbender looking at the camera on a panel at San Diego Comic-Con
W165.caption: Michael Fassbender at San Diego Comic-Con, July 2013.
W165.reason: Six months before the January 2014 article, while he was promoting 12 Years a Slave: a well-lit, face-forward head shot, 2478x3066, CC BY-SA 3.0, no restrictions. The sister frame from the same panel and the 2012 WonderCon shots are equally sharp but look off-camera; the 2011 TIFF photos are older and the 2026 Cannes and Venice photos carry a personality-rights Restrictions value.
